assumptions: Logical model abstracts measurements and arithmetic into counters/readiness and nondeterministic outcomes; L3's epoch abstraction is strengthened by concrete runtime identity checks.

Dafny verifies real/integer kernels, not the entire Python program or a floating-point compiler refinement. Runtime checks actual observed outputs against exact rational reconstruction within frozen tolerances.
Circuit generation, measurement-basis interpretation, event instrumentation, proof tools, and the independent checker are in the trusted base.
Measurements follow ideal Born probabilities, independent across groups/candidates and executions; within-group correlations are retained.
Gaussian selection is approximate; finite-shot ties use current/minus/plus priority, while the continuous Gaussian model has zero tie probability.
Ideal-energy success is a simulator benchmark oracle, not a hardware-observed stopping certificate.
The 50-update probability is the primary comparison. Other checkpoints and conditional means are supporting marginal comparisons, not a simultaneous-confidence claim.

L1.description: Complete measurements precede candidate energy aggregation

L2.description: All three candidate validations precede optimizer commitment

L3.description: Evaluation identity and parameter provenance remain current

L4.description: Termination is final and has the declared reason

N1.description: Raw counts normalize to the reported expectations

N2.description: Declared coefficients and measurements produce the actual energy

N3.description: Unique measurement groups determine physical shot consumption

N4.description: Candidate generation and selection preserve the parameter grid

P1.description: Probability of first success within the update bound

P2.description: Expected first-success update conditional on bounded success

P3.description: Expected physical shots conditional on bounded success
